args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212 in round_money

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per
FIN-212) but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the
nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py. Switch the quantize
call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent ties round to the nearest
even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
Fixes the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Problem
`src/money.py` documented banker's rounding per FIN-212 but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. This makes half-cent ties round away from zero instead of to the nearest even cent, breaking the assertion:

```
assert round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")  # banker's rounding
```

## Fix
Changed the `quantize` rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`:

```python
return amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
```

Now `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`, matching the test expectations.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`).
